reviews.title: Cancelling Flights and Not Giving Money Back
reviews.text: I had only the worst experience with this airline. First, my flight was delayed overnight due to technical reasons (as announced at the airport), but when repeatedly applying for the compensation on their website, no-one reacted. Second, my flight was cancelled and I was offered a voucher instead. The voucher was supposed to be valid for a year for all their flights, after this year, I could receive money back if I did not use the voucher. I did not use the voucher, so in a year, I asked for money back. They told me that the rules changed, and I could only use the voucher within the next 6 months for another flight. I booked a flight, the flight was cancelled, no other flight could be booked before the voucher expiration date, and I never got the money back.
reviews.author: marketaciharova

reviews.title: Changes to flights
reviews.text: I had to make changes to my ticket before travelling from New Zealand. The staff at Czech Airlines were so patient and helpful with all of my questions ( there were a lot). All changes were made successfully and any communication was prompt.
reviews.author: Nina

reviews.title: reorganization/bankrupcy scam!
reviews.text: I bought 4 tickets to Zakynthos , rebooked them 2 times with extra costs from my side (although there was stated that ''no rebooking fees'' will aply) and after that, I aplied for a voucher. I received the voucher and they went bankrupt. I couldn't use the voucher because they suspended all the flights from Copenhagen and in order to get a full refund, I had to fill in a form to the czech court (everything was in czech language. No notification or any information that they went banckrupt! nothing.. I lost 2000 euros with these scumbags. never fly with them again!
reviews.author: Sergiu

reviews.title: You can't do worse
reviews.text: I bought 3 business class tickets. CSA canceled the flight and did not refund the money. The excuse was that the times were bad.
reviews.author: Michal M

reviews.title: Terrible airline
reviews.text: Beware! This airline simply robbs people. I bought a ticket to travel back in 2020. Then covid happened and the nightmare started. Zero info about refund. Finally I was told on some forum that I need to submit info to court since they go through insolvency. Did that and no success either. Eventually I received a voucher from company stating that if I don't use it I can get a refund. Airline keeps flying but none of the destinations worked for me. Before the year passed I started contacting them. Total of 4 emails and zero response. Then ultimately all I wanted was refund and last night I managed to get through via phone. Airline told me that I lost everything because they are officially now gone through insolvency so that voucher they gave me till Feb 2023 anyway was not working since October 2022... seriously. They still fly and sell tickets but millions of people who bought tickets around 2020 mark get nothing. Also I asked why was I not informed. As a company that provides service, takes money but does not actually give the service they should at least contact people. Lady on the phone told me that too many people to contact and that we should go on their website... seriously I simply feel robbed
reviews.author: Anna Budner-Mahon

reviews.title: Cancelled my flight and did not refund
reviews.text: Czech Airlines canceled my trip in 2020 due to the Covid. I struggled a lot and I finally got vouchers. I booked new trip and at the last moment they again canceled my flight without any particular reason. I just asked for a refund for the vouchers and for some unclear reasons they denied my request!
reviews.author: Milad M

reviews.title: One english speaker and rude staff :(
reviews.text: Me and my mom took a direct flight from our hometown to Prague with this airline. They did not serve water.
reviews.author: Kristbjörg Mekkín

reviews.title: I still haven't received a refund
reviews.text: I have been waiting for a refund for two years now due to a flight cancellation by an airline. In total, I wrote about 10 support requests. I have called numerous times, but to no avail. One of the worst airlines I have ever seen.
reviews.author: Данил Ш

reviews.title: They stole my money!!! The THIEVES!!!!!!!
reviews.text: The worst company!!!! Shameless stole my money (711€) for the purchased tickets in 2019! No refunded. Kept me on "hold" for almost 3 years. As per last communication, I did hhave to call and ask for refund on 1st of Oct 2022. I called. And what I heard now? No refund possible, but I can book a flight and fly till 29/10 (what is actually within 3 within weeks!!!!!). Unrealistic, and more over... sorry but we do not fly from Belgium. And not from Amsterdam. "U can come over to Prague and fly from here than...", this is what I ve got to hear. What a hell! Czech airlines, you hold my and my children's money for almost 3 years. You profit from it for free! Illigally! Shame!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.author: Lika

reviews.title: CZ Airlines is a shame!
reviews.text: This airline is an absolute shame in every way. To flee at all costs. Tickets ordered in 2019 for a flight in 2020. Tickets canceled due to COVID but refusal of reimbursement by the company which sends (without any explanation and without my agreement) vouchers directly following the cancellation emails. A year later, at my request, these vouchers (which are only valid for 1 year) are extended a second time because the company refuses reimbursement (although promised at the end of the validity date) on the pretext that they are in a statute of protection of the firms in bankruptcy and that to obtain a refunding I would have to introduce a procedure near a Czech court! (am I dreaming?) but anyway it's too late because I'm out of time... All this happens via email and with incredible response times (when they dare answer because you have to systematically relaunch them). You don't have to be in a hurry with them... We are now at the end of validity of these second vouchers and I realize that Brussels is no longer even offered as a possible airport (nor any other in Belgium). I contact them directly by phone (in English, which they don't speak very well by the way) and they explain to me that the vouchers will expire in Oct 2022, that I just have to board at another airport that they serve (!), that they will not reimburse the vouchers and that they will not extend them either... Despite my request, my contact explains to me that no one else within the company can't give me more
reviews.author: Sylvain M

reviews.title: Taking money TWICE for extra bag
reviews.text: This is one of the worst experiences i have encountered. I had my bill PAYED for an extra luggage and the guy on the counter kept on telling me that the system says I paid only for extra weight not extra bag and this is not true because it is written on my paid bill EXCESSIVE LUGGAGE 1 pcs They told me that the problem is with Aegean airlines not with them I had to pay again because he told me hell close the boarding and the bill he gave me after I paid again has the sentence (EXCESSIVE WEIGHT )on it !!!! Pure stealing
reviews.author: Farah S

reviews.title: Wish I could give 0 stars
reviews.text: The worst airline service ever. Out plane got delayed twice and it has been 6 hours since we are at the airport. There is no communications about delays. We received no message about the delay as well. Our gate was changed multiple times and there were no announcements. We tried to reach customer service and nobody responded. We missed the whole and only day of vacation in Prague.
reviews.author: Geetanjali S

reviews.title: Poor customer service
reviews.text: They Cancel flight and do NOT issue refund - Very poor. This should be illegal, would give zero stars rating.
reviews.author: Susan F

reviews.title: Very poor airline that does not seem to get better
reviews.text: Paid for two tickets from Prague Czech Republic to Helsinki Finland. Getting close to my travel date and Czech Airlines cancels the flight. This has happened many times including earlier this year. I have tried to use this airline many times over the years and more often than not have had flight delayed or cancelled. the issue is with living in Czech and Czech Airlines being the regional carrier. Otherwise I would not use them at all.
reviews.author: navyjim58

reviews.title: Cancelled flight with no money back
reviews.text: My ticket was cancelled by CSA more than a month ago and I still can't get money back. They keep saying, that I need to wait. When I ask - how long to wait? - no answer! On top of that, my two previous flights were delayed for more than 24 hours with no reasons. Service on board is purely low cost. Do not book flights with them. Horrible
reviews.author: Yuliya533

reviews.title: They cancel flights and won't reimburse for your ticket, NEVER BOOK WITH THESE SCAMMERS
reviews.text: Me and a couple of my friends booked a flight with Czech originally in February 2020. Obviously the world shut down shortly after, so our flight was canceled. We got a voucher for our flights and waited a year. In the spring of 2021 we booked new flights with them, and they got canceled again. And lastly, we booked with them again in January, due to fly with them in April, and last week the flight got canceled again, with no explanation whatsoever. I had my doubts when we booked with them in the first place, but now my trust is completely gone, and I will never use their services again. On top of this, they won't reimburse our money back for some reason, they only offer their goddamn vouchers, which is ridiculous. Offering vouchers for a service you can't provide? I sincerely hope you go bankrupt. In summary: Terrible customer service, terrible airline, terrible company, AVOID AT ALL COSTS.
reviews.author: Jesse J

reviews.title: Terrible airline
reviews.text: Worst flying experience I have ever had! They messed up our tickets, which made us waiting till the last minute. The issue was, that in their system they saw that we bought the tickets, but they forgot to actually link the tickets to our names which created a huge mess. The staff is unprofessional, the flight was delayed, rude staff, they wanted to force us to buy their mask however we had our own and were the only passengers on board who actually wear them... Czech airlines- never again!
reviews.author: Anna K

reviews.title: Very unreliable airline
reviews.text: Cancelled flight the second time around and without informing me and ignoring my emails, requesting a refund.
reviews.author: VeronikaEss7

reviews.title: Terrible conditions and customer service
reviews.text: Last year I purchased a flight 300 EUR and the flight got canceled due to corona. I was offered a voucher for the same amount. Now I finally got to use it and had to pay extra 70 EUR for the flight. A week later I wanted to cancel one "leg" of the flight or move it to another date, However they said I only get 50 EUR back in a form of USELESS Czech airline voucher for unsused flight service fees or I have to pay additional 500 DKK to change the date. So all in all I ended up paying 320 DKK for one flight, while the price online for that flight is 70 EUR. Very very bad conditions for the customer. I can tell you I will never ever book a flight via Czech airlines anymore and you sure as hell are losing 3000 EUR every year I paid you. With this service and conditions, you for sure might remain insolvent. Too bad! Does this make sense to anyone? Not to me! Plu
reviews.author: Monika S

reviews.title: Worst company ever - flight time changed two days before flight and agressive staff
reviews.text: Our flight time was changed : we were supposed to leave at 12.25am so we can enjoy the city during morning. The time schedule changed to 7am two days before. When we arrived at the airport at 5am, the stewardess at the counter was super agressive. You should definitely take a low cost one as there is not a single advantage to take this sky team company.
reviews.author: agathou95

reviews.title: Worst airline company
reviews.text: Do not spend any money on this poor airline company. We’re trying to go in Prague since May 2020. At the beginning, we thought the covid crisis had a negative impact on their business, and tried to act with compassion. However, it seems this company is treating people as trash: no transparency, no help, no information provided while they’re going in bankrupt. And cherry on the cake: flights scheduled one year ago have been delayed a day after with no explanation.
reviews.author: Gilles S

reviews.title: Huge penalty for changing the mistake in the name.
reviews.text: For changing the wrongly entered name, they took a fine in an amount 3200 kč, that is much higher than the cost of the ticket itself (2600kč). Other companies do it for free.
reviews.author: Anton O

reviews.title: No refun
reviews.text: Despite the latest EU guidelines on consumer protection, this company has not made any effort on improving its processing time and ways of dealing with cancellations. Agents give conflicting messages and moreover it seems that they have modified some details of the initial booking like the issuing agency and the currency. All in all... never again! WizzAir and Ryanair are much more reliable than this one!
reviews.author: Elena-Luiza J

reviews.title: Flight on time, great on-board service
reviews.text: Flight on time, great on-board service, good food and nice staff. It is good to order gourmet menu or arrange upgrade to Business.
reviews.author: Martin

reviews.title: Never refunded since April 2020
reviews.text: Hi ! We have been requesting a refund for a cancelled flight since April 2020. We have reached the customer service ; no answer. As a reminder, European citizens are protected by the European legislation. We have refused a voucher offer and have the right to get a total refund. However, we never never received an answer! It is a shame and this is unacceptable !! I am addressing this message as a last chance to receive a concrete answer from Czech Airlines and the requested refund. As I have sent a message today to the customer service, I have received an answer stating that the case was closed as it got no answer for more than 10 days ... we never received an answer that we were waiting from your side.
reviews.author: Alison

reviews.title: Worst airlines every
reviews.text: Cancelling and rescheduling flights via email Alerts. It has been 3 times that they changed it. I submitted a ticket via their webpage and haven't heard back for 8 days. It is ridiculous. Reading reviews of others, I can see I am not the only one.
reviews.author: Dorota M

reviews.title: Worse airline in Europe
reviews.text: OMG, why did I go against my principles and allow myself to be scheduled on a Czech Airlines flight from Paris to Prague. I knew better and did it anyway. After many other bad trips with the Czech home country airline I should have known better. Flew with Delta from Atlanta to Paris and then was to take my Czech Airlines flight to Prague. Czech Airlines cancelled the flight shortly before I was to board supposedly due to low passenger count. I received no notice of this and guess what? No one at the Czech counter to help me and could not get them on the phone (typical of Czech Airlines). Thank goodness a decent airline staff at Delta and Air France helped me get on a much later good airline (KLM). If you want to save yourself some heartburn please Never Never try to fly with Czech Airlines. I don't know how these people stay in business?
reviews.author: navyjim58

reviews.title: They cancel your flight and don't refund your money.
reviews.text: I booked a flight in December 2020, after 3 days they cancelled my flight, since then I have been trying to get my money back, I even send them emails every day. The only thing they have sent me is a miscellaneous, which I don't want, as the flight I had booked with them was for January 2021, I needed the flight for that date, not for later. I do not recommend taking flights with this airline. It's unbelievable that you pay and they don't give you your money back, it's as if I went to the supermarket to buy, I paid and they told me that they don't have what I just bought, to come back in a year to see if they have it, but they keep the money. It's a shame.
reviews.author: Asier A

reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: The worst airline ever! the service is absolutely unacceptable! we had 2 hand luggages and no checked in bags. hand luggage was 2 kilos more than allowed and they made us check in and pay 40€ for it! when paying the service desk couldn't swipe the card so they made us go somewhere else to pay, just because she was lazy to swipe it again or try to put the card on a reader instead. the airplane was half empty but we 3 seat rows were full and they would not allow to move and its all happening during covid-19!!!! terrible
reviews.author: Mariam G

reviews.title: Utterly disappointing
reviews.text: Flight left 8 hours late. Awful service and bad communication from the CSA representatives at the gate. I am trying to get a compensation (for the entire family) for more than a year now. Their customer services is terrible. Contacted them dozens of times. They keep hiding behind their claims department. Does that even exist? See you in court CSA (not that CSA every reads or comments on reviews...) I will never ever use CSA again
reviews.author: Wilco
